vibe: Bold, edgy, rebellious, colorful, modern, unchained, forge
global_rules: Strictly avoid Inter and Roboto fonts.
Use neo-brutalism aesthetics: hard borders, stark contrast, raw structure.
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing, High Contrast Borders, Asymmetric Accents
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed width, thick right border (border-r-2 border-white/20), floating neon accents on active items.
layout_and_spacing.input_dock: Floating dock style, not edge-to-edge. border-2 border-white/20 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(255,42,109,1)] bg-background/90 backdrop-blur-xl.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF2A6D] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-widest border-2 border-white shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(255,255,255,1)] hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(255,215,0,1)] hover:bg-[#FFD700] hover:text-black transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border-2 border-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all font-bold

chat_bubbles.user: bg-[#FFD700] text-black border-2 border-black p-4 font-body font-medium rounded-br-none shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(255,42,109,1)] self-end max-w-[80%]
chat_bubbles.ai: bg-transparent text-white border-2 border-white/20 p-4 font-body rounded-bl-none shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(5,217,232,0.5)] self-start max-w-[80%]

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-2 border-white/30 text-white p-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#FFD700] focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(255,42,109,1)] transition-all placeholder:text-gray-600

markdown.container: prose prose-invert max-w-none prose-headings:font-heading prose-headings:text-white prose-p:text-gray-200 prose-a:text-[#05D9E8] hover:prose-a:text-[#FF2A6D] prose-code:font-mono prose-code:text-[#FFD700] prose-code:bg-black/50 prose-code:px-1 prose-pre:bg-[#0A0A0A] prose-pre:border-2 prose-pre:border-white/20

icons_library.style: Use bold, raw icons. Avoid overly soft or rounded icon sets.

image_urls.description: Abstract 3D rendering of a glowing futuristic digital forge, intense neon orange and cyan lights piercing through dark matte obsidian geometric shapes.
Bold minimal abstract logo icon for an AI named 'Unchained Forge', featuring a geometric flame or broken chain in vibrant hot pink and cyber yellow.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure react-router-dom for navigation.
Install framer-motion for neo-brutalist interaction physics (hard snaps, no soft fades).
Set up Tailwind with the custom colors provided in the guidelines.
Ensure the login page uses the 'login_bg' image with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60) to keep the login form legible.
Implement JWT Auth (mocked or real based on setup) with clear error states using the #FF2A6D accent color.
The chat interface MUST have a sidebar for history and a main chat area.
Use the 'ai_avatar' image for the AI's chat bubble icon.
Implement react-markdown for parsing Gemini 3 Pro responses.
Do NOT use soft shadows. All shadows must be hard 4px/8px offsets with no blur radius, conforming to the neo-brutalist aesthetic.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and clickable elements have a data-testid attribute for testing.
